title: Production of lentiviral vectors pseudotyped with influenza neuraminidase (NA)
author: George Carnell
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rkkd4uw
materials: Cells were left for a further 48h and supernatants harvested 72h post transfection, and sterile filtered through a 0.45µm filter (Merck Millipore). 48:00:00

steps.title: Prepare HEK293T/17 cells
steps.instruction: Prepare HEK293T/17 cells according to standard protocol until they reach 60-90% confluence.

steps.title: Prepare DNA-transfection mix
steps.instruction: Create a DNA mix and incubate it with a transfection reagent in Opti-MEM™.

substeps.instruction: Mix 0.5 µg of phCMV1-H11, 0.5 µg of p8.91, 0.75 µg of pCSFLW, and either 1 µg of N1/Cal09 or N2/Tex12 in 200 µl Opti-MEM™.
Incubate the mix for 20 min with PEI (17.5 µl of 1 mg/ml PEI per well of a 6-well plate) OR incubate for 25 min with Endofectin Lenti™ (3 µl/µg of DNA) per well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293T/17 cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the prepared DNA-transfection mix to the 60-90% confluent HEK293T/17 cells.

steps.title: Incubate and change medium
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells overnight and then refresh the culture medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells overnight at +37°C and 5% CO2 in a humidified incubator.
Change the cell culture medium to DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin.
